messages:
mira: Heads-up — after enabling variant-aware routing + token-budget batching in prod-sg we saw a tail latency regression around 22:30 UTC. perf-bot attached a short summary.

perf-bot: Auto-report (1833456700-1833456740): 95p latency increased 180ms -> 340ms; P99 420ms -> 760ms. Avg tokens/sec stable. KV miss rate +3.4%. No increase in errors. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

alex: Can repro in staging with route_policy=variant_aware AND token_budget=256? Was the batch size distribution different?

mira: Yes repro'd. In staging with the same traffic shape batches are smaller (mean batch tokens down ~18%) but batch fragmentation across compat sets went up a lot. We see many tiny batches that force kernel fallback to the FP16 path (our int8 kernels expect >=8 sequences), increasing per-batch overhead. KV cache warmup also regressed because variants touch slightly different cache keys -> eviction churn.

raj: Can you paste the flame/profile lines you saw? Even a few top lines helps.

mira: Sure — pasted profile excerpt below from perf-run-2026-03-16 (sampling, aggregated):

```
# timeline (ms)  count  component
0-5ms            210k   rpc_recv + parse
5-15ms           140k   batch_coalescer (many tiny batches)
15-40ms          95k    kernel_launch (FP16 path increased 2.3x)
40-120ms         12k    kv_warmup/evict
120-800ms        400    fallback_model_invoke (cold KV)
```

mira: TL;DR: fragmentation -> more small kernel invocations + KV misses -> tail latency.

sasha: Hypothesis: token_budget-only flush is starving compat-set coalescing. Two knobs to try: 1) make batch flush decision age-aware, 2) add a short compat-set coalesce window (ms) so variants in same compat set can join.

alex: +1. Maybe call it age_weighted_token_budget. Idea: maintain token_accum and earliest_seq_age; flush when token_accum >= target OR earliest_seq_age >= age_target OR token_accum weighted by compat_penalty crosses threshold. Simple pseudo-config: 

```
queue_policy:
  kind: age_weighted_token_budget
  token_target: 256
  max_age_ms: 12
  compat_penalty: 0.75  # downweights batches with mixed compat sets
```

raj: Also consider compat_coalesce_ms = 8 for compat sets that are frequently co-accessed. That lets a few more sequences join without hurting latency for single-variant hot paths.

mira: I ran a simulator with both knobs (age_weighted_token_budget + compat_coalesce_ms=8) against the staging trace: simulated P95 -> 205ms (was 340ms), P99 -> 480ms (was 760ms), mean tokens/batch +12% (so fewer tiny batches). KV miss rate dropped to +0.9% (from +3.4%).

perf-bot: Simulation summary: baseline vs tuned run on staging trace: P95 340 -> 205; P99 760 -> 480; Avg batch tokens: 14.2 -> 15.9; KV miss delta: +3.4% -> +0.9%.

alex: Nice. Two followups: 1) we should add a kernel selection hint so the runtime prefers int8 kernel when predicted effective batch size >=8 (avoids fallback), and 2) prefetch/warm KV for predicted compat variants to reduce cold miss tail.

mira: For kernel hint we can add a per-batch warmup decision: if projected_seq_count >= 8 then mark kernel_hint=int8. Quick server-side patch (toy): 

```
if projected_seq_count >= 8:
  batch.meta.kernel_hint = "int8_prefer"
else:
  batch.meta.kernel_hint = "none"
```

mira: For KV prefetch I prototyped a lazy prefetch pipeline: when routing decides a fallback variant, enqueue a prefetch for top-3 expected prefixes (from recent-prefix-histogram). Code: `prefetch.enqueue(variant, prefixes[:3])` — runs with low-priority worker.

sasha: Sounds good. Need to watch CPU spill from prefetch workers. Limit QPS for prefetch to X% of worker capacity.

ops-bot: Rolling change note: if we flip queue_policy and compat_coalesce, mark as canary to 1% users first. Also add a GAUGE for kernel_fallback_count and kv_prefetch_rate.

mira: Agreed. Proposed rollout plan: 1) staging validation (done), 2) canary 1% prod with full observability (kernel_fallback_count, avg_batch_tokens, kv_miss_rate, p95/p99), 3) ramp to 25% if P95 improves, 4) 100% after 48h stable. I'll own the canary.

alex: I'll PR the queue_policy and kernel_hint patch. Raj — can you own KV prefetch config and throttle?

raj: Yep. Will add throttles and a mode to disable prefetch per-tenant.

mira: I'll add dashboards: batch_token_dist, compat_fragmentation_ratio, kernel_fallback_count, kv_prefetch_rate, kv_miss_rate.

sasha: Add a quick unit test for batch formation that simulates two variants in same compat set arriving staggered by <=8ms.

mira: Action items summarized: 
- mira: create canary and dashboards (ETA today EOD)
- alex: PR for age_weighted_token_budget + kernel_hint (ETA tomorrow)
- raj: KV prefetch + throttle + tenant opt-out (ETA 2d)
- sasha: unit tests for coalesce window (ETA 1d)

mira: Thanks everyone. Will post canary results in this thread. :white_check_mark:
